children: Rainier Acquisition announced that holders may elect to separate Units into Class A ordinary shares and warrants, with separated shares trading as RNAQ and warrants as RNAQW.
Units (one Class A share + 1/4 warrant) may be separated starting Sept 14, 2026 to permit separate trading.
Separated Class A shares and whole warrants will begin trading on Nasdaq on Sept 15, 2026 under RNAQ and RNAQW.
No fractional warrants will be issued; only whole warrants trade and are exercisable to buy one share at $11.50.
Units not separated will continue trading on Nasdaq under RNAQU; brokers must contact the transfer agent to separate.
IPO totaled 8,625,000 Units with $86.25m gross proceeds placed in the trust account (including full overallotment).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Rainier Acquisition to Separate Class A Shares and Warrants; RNAQ, RNAQW Begin Trading Sept 15
